indexDefinition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX journey_state_renewal_episode_unique ON public.journey_state USING btree (membership_id, step, regexp_replace(instance_key, '^period:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}:'::text, 'period:'::text)) WHERE ((journey = 'renewal'::text) AND (membership_id IS NOT NULL))
